CPU_accounting_definition.exact_full_worker_interpreter_cpu: NOT_ISOLATED; end observations provided, no fabricated residual attribution
CPU_accounting_definition.raw_all_worker_cpu_field: RUSAGE_CHILDREN delta: includes all joined worker processes and their reaped Git/helper descendants, plus direct parent helper children. It is not an isolated sum of worker interpreter CPU.
CPU_accounting_definition.resource_tracker_cpu: not isolated; any child not reaped within the RUSAGE_CHILDREN window is not measured by that counter
CPU_accounting_definition.total_window: integration._run begin through joins, STOP, storage close and receipt/delivery/caller close; earlier runner activation/preflight/store creation and final observation export/mark_completed/summary JSON are excluded
CPU_accounting_definition.worker_process_end_window: sum process_time_ns in each END report; includes bootstrap, excludes post-observation send/teardown and child process CPU; do not add to RUSAGE_CHILDREN

host_outer.window: before preflight/admission through all joins, STOP, storage close, receipt/delivery/caller close

observer_overhead: not isolated: included in measured CPU and residual; no separate instrumented pass
parent_io_observations: execution_invocation.json and resources_after.json /proc/self/io; includes wrapper and postprocessing, not the exact host_outer CPU window
worker_io_window: worker before setup through normal final reporting; process bootstrap excluded
